case_title: MADAN @ MADHU PATEKAR v. THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302, sentenced to life imprisonment and fine of Rs.100/-
offence_finally_established: Murder under Section 302 of the IPC
neutral_facts: The accused poured kerosene on the victim and set her on fire, resulting in her death. The victim's dying declaration was recorded by a Special Executive Magistrate and a Head Constable, both of whom were certified by a medical officer. The victim described the incident and identified the accused as the perpetrator. The accused was arrested and charged with causing the unnatural death by burn injuries. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 of the IPC, and the High Court upheld the conviction. The accused was sentenced to life imprisonment and a fine of Rs.100/-, with an additional one-month imprisonment if the fine was not paid.
